name: sn-mcp
description: Read-only access to ServiceNow instances through your own Chrome session.
long_description: Lets Claude investigate ServiceNow instances you registered in the sn-mcp Chrome extension. It only reads, only uses your existing browser session, and only reaches an instance after you approve a request in the extension. Needs the sn-mcp native host and Chrome extension: see docs/INSTALL.md.

tools.description: Compare a record across two instances
